སེམས་དཔའ: hero, bodhisattva (sems 'mind' + dpa' 'hero'; short for byang chub sems dpa', 'hero of awakening')
ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ: Vajra-in-Hand (phyag na 'in the hand' + rdo rje 'vajra'; Sanskrit Vajrapāṇi): one of the bodhisattvas around Amoghasiddhi, in the north
སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ་བར་སེལ་བ: He Who Completely Clears Away the Obscurations (sgrib pa 'obscuration' + rnam par 'completely' + sel ba 'clearing away'; Sanskrit Sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhin): a bodhisattva of the north (the print writes rnam bar, its usual b for p)
གྷནྡྷེ་མ: Gandhā, 'she of perfume' (gandhe, the Sanskrit name in the form used in addressing her, from gandha 'scent', + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
ནཱིར་ཏི་མ: perhaps Nṛtyā, 'she of dance' (nīr ti, the print's letters, which do not plainly spell the name, + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
འདུ་བྱེད: formation, putting together ('du 'gather' + byed 'make'; Sanskrit saṃskāra): the fourth of the five aggregates, the impulses and habits by which the mind shapes what it does
ལྗང: green (ljang): ljang khu 'green'; ljang la 'green and'
སྤྲས་པ: adorned, decked (spras, past of spra 'to adorn', + -pa)
རང་རྩལ: own energy, natural play (rang 'self' + rtsal 'skill, power'): what awareness shows of itself
ཉེ་རིང: near and far (nye 'near' + ring 'far'): taking some things as one's own and others as strange
བཏང་སྙོམས: equanimity (btang 'let go', past of gtong, + snyoms 'made even')
ཆེན་པོའི: of the great (chen po 'great' + -'i 'of'): byar med chen po'i ngang du 'in the state of great non-doing'
རྒྱུ: cause (rgyu) · after a verb, what is to be, what is to happen: sangs rgyas rgyu yin pa 'it was to be that you became a buddha'
བསྒོམས་ཤིག: meditate! (bsgoms, the past stem of sgom 'meditate', here as a command, as sgoms is elsewhere, + shig, which marks a command)
དམན་པ: low, weak, inferior (dman pa): blo dman pa 'of weak mind'
ནའང: even if (na 'if' + 'ang 'even'): yin na'ang 'even if it is'
བཞོག་ཅིག: rest! leave it! (bzhog, kept as printed and read as zhog, imperative of 'jog 'to put, to leave', or a spelling of it, + cig, which marks a command)
ལྕགས་ཀྱུའི: of the iron hook (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -'i 'of')
བྲོས་ཤིག: flee! (bros, imperative of 'bros 'to flee', + shig, which marks a command); ma bros shig 'do not flee'
འབྲལ་མེད་དུ: inseparably, without parting ('bral 'part, be separated' + med 'without' + -du)
འཐབ་རྩོད: fighting and quarrel ('thab 'fight' + rtsod 'quarrel, dispute'): the life of the demigods
དྲག་བོས: by the fierce (drag bos, the print's spelling, perhaps for drag pos: drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
བྱ་གྲུབ: deeds accomplished (bya ba 'deed' + grub pa 'accomplished', shortened for the metre): bya grub ye shes 'the wisdom that accomplishes deeds'
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་བས: by Amoghasiddhi (don yod 'meaningful' + grub 'accomplished' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'by'): the buddha of the north
དམ་ཚིག་སྒྲོལ་མས: by Commitment-Saviouress (dam tshig 'commitment, vow' + sgrol ma 'saviouress', i.e. Tārā, + -s 'by'): the consort of Amoghasiddhi
ལས་འཕྲོ: karmic residue (las 'karma' + 'phro 'remainder'): what is left over of past deeds and goes on working; in this text the good karma from past lives that ties a person to the teaching
ཚན་ཆེ: strong, of great force (tshan che; read so)
དག་སྣང: pure vision (dag 'pure' + snang 'appearance'): the world seen as the deities and their realms
འདྲིས: familiar, familiarity ('dris): sngar 'dris med pa 'without earlier familiarity'
ཕྱི: outside, outer, behind, back (phyi): phyi la khrid 'led back'
འཁོར: to circle, to go round ('khor; the verb of 'khor ba, saṃsāra) · retinue, the company around a deity ('khor): 'khor dang bcas pa 'together with the retinue'
རིགས་ལྔ: the five families (rigs 'family' + lnga 'five'): the five buddhas, each with his consort and the deities of his family
བཅས་པ: together with, accompanied by (bcas pa): 'khor dang bcas pa 'together with the retinue'
རིགས་དྲུག: the six kinds (rigs 'kind' + drug 'six'): the six classes of beings, the realms of rebirth
སོ་སོའི: of each, each one's (so so 'each, separate' + -'i 'of')
སྐྲག་དངངས: fright and terror (skrag 'be frightened' + dngangs 'dread'): the same two words as dngangs skrag, in the other order
སྐྱེས་པས: because it arose, having arisen (skyes pa 'arisen' + -s 'because')
ཕན་ཆད་དུ: up to, until, from then on (phan chad 'up to, onward' + -du): da phan chad du 'until now'
ཤེས་པས: because of knowing (shes pa 'knowing' + -s 'because'): ma shes pas 'because you did not know'
སྦྱོར: to join, to unite (sbyor, the present stem; past and future sbyar): ye shes bzhi sbyor 'the four wisdoms joined'
པདྨ་བརྩེགས་པ: Lotus-Heaped (padma 'lotus' + brtsegs pa 'heaped up, stacked', past of rtseg): a second name, or a description, of the western buddha-field, which the text does not make clear
ཕྱི་རིམ་དུ: in the outer tier, on the outer ring (phyi 'outer' + rim 'tier, ring' + -du 'in')
སྒོ་བ: gatekeeper (sgo 'gate' + -ba, here 'the one of the gate')
རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བ: Fully Victorious (rnam par 'completely' + rgyal ba 'victorious'; Sanskrit Vijaya): one of the four wrathful male gatekeepers, named first in this text
གཤིན་རྗེ་གཤེད་པོ: Slayer of the Lord of Death (gshin rje 'lord of the dead' + gshed po 'slayer'; Sanskrit Yamāntaka): a wrathful male gatekeeper
རྟ་མགྲིན་རྒྱལ་པོ: Horse-Neck, the king (rta 'horse' + mgrin 'neck' + rgyal po 'king'; Sanskrit Hayagrīva): a wrathful male gatekeeper
བདུད་རྩི་འཁྱིལ་པ: Coil of Nectar (bdud rtsi 'nectar' + 'khyil pa 'coiled, swirling'; Sanskrit Amṛtakuṇḍalin): a wrathful male gatekeeper
ལྕགས་ཀྱུ་མ: Iron-Hook Lady (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the hook she holds
ཞགས་པ་མ: Noose Lady (zhags pa 'noose' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the noose she holds
ལྕགས་སྒྲོག་མ: Iron-Chain Lady (lcags 'iron' + sgrog 'chain' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the chain she holds
དྲིལ་བུ་མ: Bell Lady (dril bu 'bell' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the bell she holds
ཐུབ་པ: able, capable (thub 'to be able' + -pa) · the sage, the Able One (Sanskrit muni): a buddha who appears in each of the six realms of rebirth to teach its beings
དབང་པོ་བརྒྱ་བྱིན: Lord of a Hundred Offerings (dbang po 'lord' + brgya 'hundred' + byin 'given', past of sbyin 'give'; Sanskrit Śatakratu, 'of a hundred sacrifices'): Indra, king of the gods, here the sage of the gods
ཐག་བཟང་རིས: Good-Weave-Pattern (thag 'weave, rope' + bzang 'good' + ris 'pattern'): the king of the demigods, Sanskrit Vemacitra; here the sage of the demigods
ཤཱཀྱ་སེངྒེ: Lion of the Śākyas (Śākya, the clan of the Buddha, + seng ge 'lion'; Sanskrit Śākyasiṃha): the Buddha of our age, the sage of humans
བྱོལ་སོང: animal (byol song): one of the six kinds of beings
སེངྒེ་རབ་བརྟན: Very Steadfast Lion (seng ge 'lion' + rab 'very' + brtan 'steadfast'): the sage of the animals
ཁ་འབར་མ: Blazing Mouth (kha 'mouth' + 'bar 'blaze' + -ma, which usually marks a woman): the sage of the hungry ghosts
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ: King of the Teaching, dharma king (chos 'teaching' + kyi 'of' + rgyal po 'king'; Sanskrit dharmarāja): the sage of the hell beings
སྤྱི་མེས: common forefather (spyi 'general, of all' + mes 'grandfather, ancestor')
ཀུན་བཟང: All-Good (kun 'all' + bzang 'good'): the short form of Kun tu bzang po, Samantabhadra
ལོངས་སྐུའི: of the body of enjoyment (longs sku, short for longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku, + -'i 'of')
བཞི་བཅུ་རྩ་གཉིས: forty-two (bzhi bcu 'forty' + rtsa, which joins the units to the tens, + gnyis 'two')
ཀྱེ: O! (kye, a word of calling; the print's other spelling of kyai)
ཞིག: a, some, one (zhig, the form of cig, gcig 'one', after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; shig after s): gzhan zhig 'some other, another'
ཕྱོགས: direction, quarter, side (phyogs): phyogs bzhi 'the four quarters'
ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པ: present of itself, spontaneously accomplished (lhun gyis 'of itself' + grub pa 'accomplished'): a fixed term for what is there without being made

__broaden__.ཁྲིད: guidance, a lama's step-by-step instruction in practice · to lead, guide (khrid, past and imperative stem of 'khrid 'to lead')

ལས་རབ་རྫོགས་པའི: of Fully Accomplished Action (las 'action, deeds' + rab 'very' + rdzogs 'complete' + -pa'i 'of'): read as the name of the buddha-field of the north (las may also be taken as 'from' before rab rdzogs pa'i, as it was before rab brtsegs pa'i)
